question: A researcher compares the two main cell types in the islets of Langerhans. Which pairing correctly links a cell type, its hormone and the hormone's effect?

content.text: A researcher compares the two main cell types in the islets of Langerhans. Which pairing correctly links a cell type, its hormone and the hormone's effect?

options.label: A
options.text: Alpha cells — insulin — lowers blood glucose

options.label: B
options.text: Beta cells — glucagon — raises blood glucose

options.label: C
options.text: Beta cells — insulin — enhances cellular glucose uptake

options.label: D
options.text: Alpha cells — glucagon — stimulates conversion of glucose into glycogen

explanation: Pancreatic beta cells secrete insulin, which increases glucose uptake and use by target cells and promotes glycogen formation, lowering blood glucose. Alpha cells secrete glucagon, which raises blood glucose by promoting glycogen breakdown and formation of glucose from non-carbohydrate sources. Therefore, only option C correctly combines the cell type, hormone and effect.
reference: NCERT Biology, Class XI, Chemical Coordination and Integration, section 19.2.8 Pancreas, pp. 245–246, reprint 2026–27. https://ncert.nic.in/textbook/pdf/kebo119.pdf
